title: Synthetic Protocol for Assembling Giant Heterometallic Hydroxide Clusters from Building Blocks: Rational Design and Efficient Synthesis

material_class.structural_family: Box-like 3d–4f hydroxide cluster with 5 × 5 × 3 parallelepiped topology

synthesis.procedure: Prepare solution A by dissolving La(NO3)3·6H2O, Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and iminodiacetic acid in distilled water, heating to 80 °C, and adding aqueous NaOH. Separately prepare solution B from the same three starting materials in water; transfer 0.2 mL of that mixture to a beaker and add aqueous NaOH. Add B to A, stir for 2 h, and filter into a glass beaker. Cool to room temperature overnight; collect the blue-green parallelepiped crystals by filtration and dry in air at room temperature.

reagents.name: Lanthanum(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 1.0 mmol in solution A; 2 mmol in the stock mixture for solution B

reagents.name: Nickel(II) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 1.0 mmol in solution A; 4 mmol in the stock mixture for solution B

reagents.name: Iminodiacetic acid
reagents.amount: 1.0 mmol in solution A; 4 mmol in the stock mixture for solution B

reagents.name: Sodium hydroxide solution
reagents.amount: 3.5 mL of 1.0 M in solution A; 0.36 mL of 1 M added to a 0.2 mL aliquot for solution B

solvents: Distilled water (5 mL for solution A; 10 mL for the solution B stock mixture)
synthesis.temperature: Solution A heated to 80 °C; crystallization and drying at room temperature
synthesis.time: 2 h stirring after mixing; overnight crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Separate aqueous precursor solutions followed by mixing and crystallization in a glass beaker
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the mixed solution, cool overnight, then filter and air-dry the crystals at room temperature.

properties.summary: The nickel ions show weak overall ferromagnetic behavior; the low-temperature decrease in χmT is attributed to intercluster antiferromagnetic interactions and Ni(II) zero-field splitting.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: Room temperature; susceptibility measured under 1,000 Oe

measurements.name: Curie–Weiss temperature θ
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit reported in the Magnetic Properties section
